description: Rates the HTS states in a chapter's additional U.S. notes instead of the rate columns ("See additional U.S. note 3"). The calculator prices the note's rate for the line's column; the rate text is the note's own wording. Reviewed against the official chapter text; re-check per HTS revision (pnpm tariff:rate-parse fails when a column says "See additional U.S. note n" and no entry here matches).
